'''2008 Texas Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event in Texas in 2008. [[Kevin Shannon]] won "through the field of 29 people"; [[Scott Lingrell]] was 2nd, and [[Joe Olson]] and [[Greg Shaw]] completed the top 4 (Players Committee news of 1 May 2008).<ref name="pc-sid85">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132641/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=85 Kevin Shannon wins the Texas MPC] (1 May 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 August 2008.</ref> The Players Committee's decklist PDF ([[:File:2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]) holds eight Day 2 deck printouts (printed 29 April 2008) that give only the players' first names (Greg, Joe, Kevin and Scott), so they are not yet published as decklists here.

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 2008
* '''Players:''' 29<ref name="pc-sid85" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]<ref name="pc-sid85" />
